Write code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — AssemblyAI:
  Service: AssemblyAI Transcripts API
  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_transcription_job, get_transcription_job
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 3 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import assemblyai
import os
import time

def transcribe_meeting_with_diarization(audio_url: str) -> dict:
    """
    Transcribes a recorded meeting from an audio URL, including speaker diarization.

    Args:
        audio_url: The URL of the audio file to transcribe.

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing the transcription result with speaker diarization.
    """
    # Initialize the AssemblyAI client
    # AssemblyAI API key can be set as an environment variable ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
    # or passed directly: client = assemblyai.Client(api_key="YOUR_ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
    client = assemblyai.Client()

    # Submit the transcription job with speaker diarization enabled
    transcript = client.transcripts.submit(
        audio=audio_url,
        speaker_diarization=True
    )

    # Poll for the transcription to complete
    while transcript.status != assemblyai.TranscriptStatus.completed and \
          transcript.status != assemblyai.TranscriptStatus.error:
        time.sleep(1) # Wait for 1 second before checking again
        transcript = client.transcripts.get(transcript.id)

    if transcript.status == assemblyai.TranscriptStatus.completed:
        # Return the complete transcription object, which includes diarization segments
        return transcript.model_dump() # Convert the Transcript object to a dictionary
    elif transcript.status == assemblyai.TranscriptStatus.error:
        raise Exception(f"Transcription failed: {transcript.error}")
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Transcription ended with unexpected status: {transcript.status}")
